# SECTOR 7

> Free, offline-capable space combat game. No build step, no dependencies, no
> art assets — everything is drawn procedurally on a canvas.

SECTOR 7 is a browser game in which energy is a physical cargo: you mine it
from asteroids, carry it in a hold, and it is only yours once you have docked
at the station and banked it. If your hull goes out in the field, the hold
goes with it.

## Canonical

https://lucagandolfi77.github.io/random2/sector7-pwa/

## The one rule the game is built on

Shields and armour are two separate pools, and armour is not touched while any
shield remains. A laser eats armour and bounces off shields; the capacitor
round is the reverse. Which gun is correct is therefore a property of what you
are shooting, not of which one you upgraded last — and no upgrade in the game
may change that ratio.

## Factions

Six, each with its own shield fraction and its own behaviour: Raider (no
shields, swarm), Drone (faint shields, fast, never breaks off), Pirate
(half-shielded, either weapon works), Cruiser (light shields on a big hull,
fights at long range), Alien (shield-dominant — bring ammo), Hive (almost pure
shield, spawns its own). They are also hostile to each other.

## Maps

Ten: four frontier sectors (Rook, Kestrel, Vanta, Maw) and one territory per
faction (Scrapyard, The Pin, Pogo Reach, Long Reach, Demaner, The Hive), each
carrying a raidable base.

## Ships

Eight hulls, each with one passive that changes what the ship is: Wasp,
Hauler, Warden, Bulwark, Vandal, Lance, Hound, Oracle.

## SARTORIA

A separate PWA in the same repo: <https://lucagandolfi77.github.io/random2/sartoria-pwa/>

> Couture tycoon. Dress mannequins, respect client briefs, guess noisy
> trends — and you get ONE runway show per season.

The scarce resource is the season, not money: one collection per season per
city, and the trend forecast publishes two tags while staying silent about a
third. Betting on the wrong tag costs the whole season, and three rival
designers read the same forecast.

Systems: colour harmony computed on the wheel (complementary +24, analogous
+16, monochrome +9, clashing −14) · 96 garments across 6 slots · 8 style tags ·
10 colours · 7 fabrics that cost money on every look · models whose stamina
drops during a show · judges with individual bias and strictness · 6 cities ×
3 venues · 4 show types that each change one scoring rule · 40 levels.

## Modes

- **Patrol** — no clock. Mine, fight, bank.
- **Wave** — survive 8 escalating waves from a portal, paid in crystals.
- **Haul** — land a full payload at the station before the timer runs out.

## Controls

| Action | Touch | Keyboard |
|---|---|---|
| Fly | left thumb, anywhere — the stick appears where you press | `WASD` / arrows |
| Blaster | `FIRE` (hold) | `Space` |
| Ammo | `AMMO` — one press, one capacitor round | `X` |
| Missiles | `MSL` | `M` |
| Mines | `MINE` | `B` |
| CPU | `CPU` | `F` |
| Target | tap right of screen; `T` cycles | `T` |
| Dock | hold `DOCK` in the station ring | hold `E` |
